items.title: EPG-enriched ad requests with CloudFront Functions and AWS Elemental MediaTailor
items.summary: Linear TV ad requests often carry stale program metadata because viewer sessions stay open for hours while programs change. We show how to enrich every ad break with current EPG metadata using Amazon CloudFront Functions, CloudFront KeyValueStore, and AWS Elemental MediaTailor Monetization Functions, at about $14 per month.
items.creator: Ian Oatley
